codes.summary: Raised where a policy that lives inside a limit was chosen without one.

codes.meaning: The request named is not one that is waiting on anybody, so there is nothing to rule on.
codes.name: NOT_WAITING
codes.remedy: Ask what the household has asked for, to see what is still waiting.
codes.summary: Raised where the request named is not one that is waiting on anybody.

codes.meaning: A request was turned down and the reason given was blank. The reason is passed on to whoever asked, so a blank one tells them nothing.
codes.name: NO_REASON
codes.remedy: Say why in a few words, and pass them on to whoever asked.
codes.summary: Raised where a request was turned down and the reason said nothing.

codes.meaning: Nobody in this household goes by the name that was given, so nothing was changed.
codes.name: NOBODY
codes.remedy: Name somebody who is here. The message lists the household.
codes.summary: Raised where nobody in the household goes by the name that was given.

codes.meaning: The request service holds no account for somebody who has one here. It learns of somebody the first time they sign in to it, and until then there is no account of theirs for a limit to sit on — what the household is held to applies to them meanwhile.
codes.name: NEVER_HERE
codes.remedy: Ask them to open the request service once, then set this again.
codes.summary: Raised where the request service holds no account for somebody who has one here.

codes.meaning: A run was asked to close what has waited too long, and this household has never said how long that is. A request closed against a period nobody named is one nobody agreed to close.
codes.name: NOTHING_AGREED
codes.remedy: Say how many days a request may wait, as in `lemonfiber household expiring --after 30`.
codes.summary: Raised where a run was asked to close what has waited too long and the household has never said how long that is.

codes.meaning: The period named would close a request nobody was ever reminded about. The reminder and the closing are one arrangement, and a request that goes before the reminder is one nobody saw waiting.
codes.name: TOO_SOON
codes.remedy: Name a period of a week or more, so the reminder is reached first.
codes.summary: Raised where the period named would close a request nobody was ever reminded about.

codes.meaning: A limit was expressed as a share of a line nothing has measured, so the share is not a limit.
codes.name: NOTHING_MEASURED
codes.remedy: Say what the line carries, or give a figure instead of a share.
codes.summary: Raised when a limit is expressed as a share of a line nothing has measured.

codes.meaning: A schedule was asked for and nothing says which zone the download clients would read it in.
codes.name: NO_ZONE
codes.remedy: Set the zone, then ask again.
codes.summary: Raised when a schedule is asked for and nothing says which zone the clients would read it in.

codes.meaning: What was asked for could not be read as a limit, a window or a cap. A cap has to be told what happens when it is reached.
codes.name: UNREADABLE
codes.remedy: Say what happens at the cap: `--when-exceeded pause`, `throttle` or `continue`.
codes.summary: Raised when what was asked for could not be read as a limit, a window or a cap.

codes.meaning: There is no download client on this stack to hold to a limit.
codes.name: NOTHING_TO_LIMIT
codes.remedy: Start a form that has a download client in it.
codes.summary: Raised when there is no download client to limit.

codes.meaning: There is no download client on this stack to pause or resume. A pause is asked of the download clients themselves, and this stack declares none, so nothing is taking the line either.
codes.name: NOTHING_TO_PAUSE
codes.remedy: Start a form that has a download client in it, as in `lemonfiber up tv`.
codes.summary: Raised when there is no download client to pause or resume.

codes.meaning: What was agreed to is not what pausing or resuming would change now. A download client was added or removed, or one changed by itself, since this was rehearsed, so no client was told anything.
codes.name: PAUSING_MOVED
codes.remedy: Rehearse it again, and answer the offer it gives now.
codes.summary: Raised where pausing or resuming the download clients names an offer that is not the one a fresh look at them builds.

codes.meaning: The read you asked for takes no parameter by that name. It is refused rather than ignored, because ignoring it would answer a wider question than the one that was asked, and a wider answer reads like the answer.
codes.name: UNWANTED
codes.remedy: Ask again, naming only what this read takes. The message lists them.
codes.summary: Raised where a read was given a parameter its answer has nowhere to put.

codes.meaning: A parameter that names one thing was given more than once. Which of them was meant is not something this can work out, and answering for one of them would drop the others without saying so.
codes.name: REPEATED
codes.remedy: Ask again, naming it once.
codes.summary: Raised where a parameter carrying one value was given more than once.

codes.meaning: There is no read by that name. Every read this surface answers is named in the contract, and this name is not one of them.
codes.name: NO_SUCH_READ
codes.remedy: Ask for one of the reads the contract names. [The envelope](https://docs.lemonfiber.app/api/the-envelope/) sets them out.
codes.summary: Raised where no read goes by the name that was asked for.

codes.meaning: A trace was asked for and named nothing to follow.
codes.name: NO_TERM
codes.remedy: Ask again, naming what to follow.
codes.summary: Raised where a trace was asked for and named nothing to follow.

codes.meaning: The season to narrow a trace to is not a number.
codes.name: NOT_A_SEASON
codes.remedy: Ask again with the season as a number.
codes.summary: Raised where the season to narrow a trace to is not a number.

codes.meaning: A setting was asked for by an empty name. Naming no setting asks for every one; an empty name would match none of them, and come back as no such setting about a setting nobody named.
codes.name: NO_SETTING
codes.remedy: Name the setting, or leave it off to read every one.
codes.summary: Raised where a setting was asked for by an empty name.

codes.meaning: A household member was asked for by an empty name. Naming nobody asks about the whole household; an empty name would match nobody, and read as nobody having asked for anything.
codes.name: NO_MEMBER
codes.remedy: Name the member, or leave it off to read the whole household.
codes.summary: Raised where a household member was asked for by an empty name.

codes.meaning: A shelf was asked for and nobody was named whose it is. There is no everybody to fall back to: a shelf is what one account may watch, and no two accounts need hold the same one.
codes.name: NO_SHELF_WITHOUT_A_MEMBER
codes.remedy: Ask again, naming whose shelf to read.
codes.summary: Raised where a shelf was asked for and nobody was named whose it is.

codes.meaning: How many holdings to answer with is not a whole number above nought. A shelf of no holdings is a request for an answer that says nothing.
codes.name: NOT_A_COUNT
codes.remedy: Ask again with a whole number, or leave it off.
codes.summary: Raised where how many holdings to answer with is not a whole number.

codes.meaning: More holdings were asked for than one read answers with. It is refused rather than cut down, because a shorter answer wearing the shape of the whole one reads as the whole shelf.
codes.name: TOO_MANY_AT_ONCE
codes.remedy: Ask again for fewer.
codes.summary: Raised where more holdings were asked for than one read answers with.

codes.meaning: A diagnosis was narrowed to a group of checks, or a check, that is not one. Reading the word as the nearest one would answer something that was not asked.
codes.name: NO_SUCH_GROUP
codes.remedy: Name a group of checks, or one check by the name a finding gives it.
codes.summary: Raised where a diagnosis was narrowed to a group or check that is not one.

codes.meaning: A removal was named that is none of the four there are: stop, services, configuration or media. Reading the word as the nearest one would answer something that was not asked.
codes.name: NO_SUCH_REMOVAL
codes.remedy: Name one of the four, or none to read the one that removes nothing.
codes.summary: Raised where a removal was named that is none of the four there are.

codes.meaning: Moving forward was asked about and neither `stack` nor `self` was named. Neither is the smaller case of the other — one moves your services, the other this program — so answering with either would answer the wrong question.
codes.name: NO_UPDATE_OBJECT
codes.remedy: Ask again, naming `stack` or `self`.
codes.summary: Raised where moving forward was asked about and neither stack nor self named.

codes.meaning: How many log lines to begin with is not a number, or is more than one read begins with. The message names the ceiling.
codes.name: NOT_A_LINE_COUNT
codes.remedy: Ask again with a number no larger than the message names.
codes.summary: Raised where how many log lines to begin with is not a number within the ceiling.

codes.meaning: Whether to keep reading is neither true nor false.
codes.name: NOT_A_CHOICE
codes.remedy: Ask again with `true` or `false`, or leave it off.
codes.summary: Raised where a parameter that takes a yes or a no is neither true nor false.

codes.meaning: A household read named a member and asked for the household's defaults as well. Those are two different answers, and one reply cannot be both.
codes.name: MEMBER_AND_DEFAULTS
codes.remedy: Ask again for one of them: a member, or the household's defaults.
codes.summary: Raised where a household read named a member and asked for the household's defaults as well.

codes.meaning: This command cannot be rehearsed and never will be: what it would find out is only knowable by doing it, so a rehearsal would be a report with nothing in it. Nothing was done. The message says which command and why.
codes.name: CANNOT
codes.remedy: Run the command without `--dry-run` when you mean it.
codes.summary: The flag cannot be honoured by this command, and never will be.

codes.meaning: This command changes things and has not been taught to say what it would change, so it refuses the flag rather than accepting it and going ahead. Nothing was done.
codes.name: NOT_YET
codes.remedy: Run the command without `--dry-run` when you mean it, or wait for it.
codes.summary: The flag is not honoured by this command yet.

codes.meaning: The media server would not say who holds an account, so nothing was reset. Making an account claimable again starts by finding it, and that read did not answer.
codes.name: UNREADABLE
codes.remedy: Check the media server is running, then run this again.
codes.summary: Said where the media server will not say who holds an account.

codes.meaning: Nobody by that name is in this household. Nothing was reset — the name has to match an account the media server holds, though not its capitalisation.
codes.name: NOBODY_HERE
codes.remedy: Run `lemonfiber household` to see who is here.
codes.summary: Said where nobody by that name is in the household.

codes.meaning: The account named administers the media server, so its password is not one to reset. This is the account lemonfiber signs in as, and taking its password away would leave nothing to sign in with.
codes.name: RUNS_THE_SERVER
codes.remedy: Reset a household member instead. To change the administrator's own password, do it in the media server's settings.
codes.summary: Said where the account named administers the server.

codes.meaning: The media server would not reset that password, so nothing changed. Their existing password still works and the account is untouched.
codes.name: WOULD_NOT_REISSUE
codes.remedy: Check the media server is running, then run this again.
codes.summary: Said where the media server refused to make the account claimable again.

codes.meaning: No name was given, so there is nobody to remove. Removing somebody takes the name their account is held under.
codes.name: NOBODY_NAMED
codes.remedy: Name the person, as they appear in `lemonfiber household`.
codes.summary: Said where the removal is for nobody: the name is blank, or only spaces.

codes.meaning: This stack has no media server, so there is no household to remove anybody from. A household member is an account on the media server; without one there is nobody to take away.
codes.name: NO_MEDIA_SERVER
codes.remedy: Add a media server to the stack and run setup.
codes.summary: Said where the stack holds no media server: there is no account to remove.

codes.meaning: The media server would not say who holds an account, so nobody was removed. Removing somebody starts by finding their account, and that read did not answer.
codes.name: UNREADABLE
codes.remedy: Check the media server is running, then run this again.
codes.summary: Said where the media server will not say who it holds.

codes.meaning: Nobody by that name is in this household. Nothing was removed — the name has to match an account the media server holds, though not its capitalisation.
codes.name: NOBODY_HERE
codes.remedy: Run `lemonfiber household` to see who is here.
codes.summary: Said where nobody by that name is in the household.

codes.meaning: The account named administers the media server, so it is not one to remove. The server refuses to be left without an administrator, and this is also the account lemonfiber signs in as.
codes.name: RUNS_THE_SERVER
codes.remedy: Remove a household member instead. To hand the server to somebody else, do it in the media server's own settings first.
codes.summary: Said where the account named administers the server.

codes.meaning: The media server would not remove that account, so nothing was removed. Nothing else was touched: the request service is only asked once the media server's account is gone.
codes.name: WOULD_NOT_REMOVE
codes.remedy: Check the media server is running, then run this again.
codes.summary: Said where the media server refused to remove the account.

codes.meaning: What you agreed to is not what is offered now. A fresh look offers something else, so something changed between reading the offer and answering it. Nothing was carried out.
codes.name: STALE
codes.remedy: Ask what could be put right again, and read what it says now.
codes.summary: Raised when consent was given for an offer that no longer stands.

codes.meaning: This run has nowhere it knows to look for what a repair changed. What each repair changed is recorded in lemonfiber's own directory, and this machine would not say where that is. Nothing was put back.
codes.name: NOWHERE_TO_LOOK
codes.remedy: Set a home directory for this user, then ask again.
codes.summary: Raised when a run cannot say where lemonfiber's own files are.

codes.meaning: Saying what could be put right does not include the checks that disturb. Those checks prove themselves by disturbing — the killswitch test takes the tunnel away from the download client, and the release check spends one of the indexers' daily searches — and a run that only says what it would put right has agreed to neither. Nothing was disturbed.
codes.name: OFFER_CANNOT_DISTURB
codes.remedy: Ask for the diagnosis with those checks in it, with `lemonfiber doctor --disruptive`. Or agree to the repairs first, and the checks that disturb run with them.
codes.summary: Raised when a run that may not act was asked for the checks that disturb.

codes.meaning: The archive could not be read. Most often it is truncated, or is not a lemonfiber backup. Nothing was touched.
codes.name: CORRUPT
codes.remedy: Check the archive, or restore from a different backup.
codes.summary: Raised when a backup archive cannot be read to decide a restore.

codes.meaning: The archive was written by a newer lemonfiber than this one, and may hold configuration this version would not restore correctly. Nothing was touched.
codes.name: TOO_NEW
codes.remedy: Update lemonfiber to at least the version that made the backup, then restore.
codes.summary: Raised when an archive was written by a newer lemonfiber than this one.

codes.meaning: The archive's format cannot be restored by this build. Restoring it could leave the configuration in a state neither version expects. Nothing was touched.
codes.name: INCOMPATIBLE
codes.remedy: Restore it with the lemonfiber version that made it.
codes.summary: Raised when an archive's format cannot be restored by this build.

codes.meaning: The archive holds an entry naming a path that leaves the directory it belongs in, which a genuine lemonfiber backup never does. It is refused and nothing was touched.
codes.name: UNSAFE
codes.remedy: Do not restore this archive. It is corrupt, or was tampered with.
codes.summary: Raised when an archive holds a member that would be written outside its area.

codes.meaning: The archive was taken against a different data root. Restoring it unchanged would keep a setting naming a location that is not on this machine.
codes.name: NEEDS_REPOINT
codes.remedy: Re-run the restore with `--repoint` to accept moving it to this machine's data root.
codes.summary: Raised when a restore onto a different data root awaits the operator's consent.

codes.meaning: The archive could not be unpacked, and the restore stopped part-way through writing the configuration back.
codes.name: NOT_RESTORED
codes.remedy: Check the configuration location is writable and restore again. A seed afterwards reconciles anything left half-written.
codes.summary: Raised when an archive could not be unpacked.

codes.meaning: The stack was not confirmed stopped, so nothing was touched. A restore writes over the service databases, and an engine that will not say whether the services are running is refused as firmly as one that says they are.
codes.name: STILL_RUNNING
codes.remedy: Stop the stack, check the container engine is answering, then restore again.
codes.summary: Raised when a restore could not be shown that nothing is writing to a database.

codes.meaning: The name you gave is not one of the backups kept here. A restore by name reaches one of the archives this machine took, which are files in a single directory; a name carrying a path, or climbing out of that directory, is refused rather than followed. Nothing was touched.
codes.name: NOT_KEPT_HERE
codes.remedy: Ask for one of the backups by the name it was written under.
codes.summary: Raised when a name does not name one of the backups this machine kept.

codes.meaning: This run has nowhere it knows to look for a backup. Archives are kept in lemonfiber's own directory, and this machine would not say where that is. Nothing was touched.
codes.name: NOWHERE_KEPT
codes.remedy: Set a home directory for this user, then restore again.
codes.summary: Raised when this run has nowhere it knows to look for an archive.

codes.meaning: The archive was unpacked, and the data root it recorded could not be changed to this machine's — so the settings that landed name a library that is not here.
codes.name: NOT_REPOINTED
codes.remedy: Set the data root by hand, then run `lemonfiber seed`.
codes.summary: Raised when the restored settings could not be pointed at this machine's data root.

codes.meaning: What you agreed to is not what this backup would do now. A fresh look at the archive lists something else, so something changed between reading the listing and answering it. Nothing was overwritten.
codes.name: MOVED_ON
codes.remedy: Ask what the backup holds again, and read what it says now.
codes.summary: Raised when consent was given for a listing that no longer stands.

codes.meaning: The archive holds a setup lemonfiber does not manage. It was captured before lemonfiber took over, so putting it back means writing into directories that are not lemonfiber's to write to. Nothing was touched.
codes.name: NOT_OURS
codes.remedy: Unpack it yourself with `tar -xzf`, into the paths the message names.
codes.summary: Raised when the archive holds trees lemonfiber does not manage.

codes.meaning: A service was not answering yet, so it was skipped. Nothing was changed for it.
codes.name: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
codes.remedy: Wait for it to finish starting, then run `lemonfiber seed` again.
codes.summary: Raised when a service is not answering yet.

codes.meaning: A service rejected the credential lemonfiber holds, usually because it was changed in the service's own interface.
codes.name: SERVICE_UNAUTHORISED
codes.remedy: Have lemonfiber re-read the service's credential with `lemonfiber doctor --fix`.
codes.summary: Raised when a service rejects the credential lemonfiber holds.

codes.meaning: A service answered in a way lemonfiber does not recognise, so it will not guess at what would fix it.
codes.name: SERVICE_REFUSED
codes.remedy: Nothing is known to fix this. Send a [support bundle](https://docs.lemonfiber.app/fixing/the-support-bundle/); the service's own words are attached to the message.
codes.summary: Raised when a service answers with something unusable.

codes.meaning: A service is past — or stands before — the API version this build speaks, so writing to it would mean writing something malformed. Nothing was changed for it.
codes.name: SERVICE_UNSUPPORTED
codes.remedy: Match the service to the version lemonfiber supports, or update lemonfiber, then run `lemonfiber seed` again.
codes.summary: Raised when a service does not serve the API version this build speaks.

codes.meaning: The address could not be taken, so there is nowhere for a browser to connect. Usually something else on this machine is already listening there.
codes.name: ADDRESS_TAKEN
codes.remedy: Ask for a different port with `lemonfiber ui --port 7171`, or name no port at all and be given a free one.
codes.summary: Raised when the address the surface was asked to serve on cannot be taken.

codes.meaning: A token could not be minted for this run. Every request to this surface has to carry a secret only that run knows, and this machine would not supply the unpredictable bytes it is made of.
codes.name: NO_TOKEN
codes.remedy: Run it again. If it happens twice, the operating system's own random source is at fault.
codes.summary: Raised when this machine will not supply the randomness a token is made of.

codes.meaning: The web interface was asked to answer your network and no password is set, so it was not offered. This surface can start, stop and reconfigure everything and reaches every password the system holds, so anything on that network could do all of that.
codes.name: NO_PASSWORD
codes.remedy: Set a password and ask again, with `lemonfiber ui --set-password --lan`. Or leave it as it is, and reach it from this machine.
codes.summary: Raised when the network was asked for and nothing here can say who is knocking.

codes.meaning: Serving encrypted was asked for with no port named. Serving encrypted is for a paired phone, and a phone keeps the address it was given, so a port chosen afresh on every run is one it would stop reaching the next time this started.
codes.name: UNSETTLED_PORT
codes.remedy: Name the port, as in `lemonfiber ui --tls --port <port>`.
codes.summary: Raised when serving encrypted was asked for with no port that stays the same.

codes.meaning: It could not serve encrypted. It presents a certificate it keeps beside its configuration, and that certificate could not be read or made; the message says which.
codes.name: NO_CERTIFICATE
codes.remedy: Replace the certificate with `lemonfiber companion certificate --confirm`, knowing every paired phone will need pairing again.
codes.summary: Raised when the certificate to serve encrypted with cannot be read or made.

codes.meaning: An answer could not be rendered. The request was understood and carried out, and what it came to could not be written down as an answer. Nothing about the request was wrong.
codes.name: UNRENDERABLE
codes.remedy: Ask again. If it keeps happening, send a support bundle, made with `lemonfiber support`.
codes.summary: Raised when an answer could not be rendered.

codes.meaning: Work that outlives its request could not be named, because this machine would not supply the randomness a job's name is made of. A job with no name is work nothing could ever be told about, so it was not begun, and nothing was changed.
codes.name: NO_JOB_NAME
codes.remedy: Ask again. If it keeps happening, send a support bundle, made with `lemonfiber support`.
codes.summary: Raised when this machine will not supply the randomness a job is named with.

codes.meaning: An action stopped before it had an answer to give. It may have changed something before it stopped, and sending it again runs it again.
codes.name: UNANSWERED
codes.remedy: Ask again. If it keeps happening, send a support bundle, made with `lemonfiber support`.
codes.summary: Raised when an action's work ended before it had an answer to give.

codes.meaning: Setup was asked to apply before its answers were reviewed. Nothing has been written.
codes.name: NOT_REVIEWED
codes.remedy: Answer every question, then confirm the review before applying.
codes.summary: Raised when apply is asked for before the answers have been reviewed.

codes.meaning: The data directory you chose could not be created. Setup stopped; the next run recovers it.
codes.name: DIR_NOT_MADE
codes.remedy: Check the location is on a writable disk, then try again.
codes.summary: Raised when the operator's chosen data directory cannot be created.

codes.meaning: A directory left by an interrupted setup could not be removed. The rest was reversed; this one directory holds nothing.
codes.name: NOT_REMOVED
codes.remedy: Remove it by hand, or leave it where it is.
codes.summary: Raised when a directory from an interrupted apply could not be removed.

codes.meaning: Reversing a change needs the service that made it. Settings and directories were reversed; a resource a service created was not.
codes.name: NEEDS_SERVICE
codes.remedy: Reverse it from the service itself, once that service is reachable.
codes.summary: Raised when reversing needs the service that made a change.

codes.meaning: An answer is not meaningful on the platform setup is running on. Nothing has been applied.
codes.name: DOES_NOT_APPLY
codes.remedy: Answer with a choice this platform offers.
codes.summary: Raised when an answer is not meaningful on the platform setup is running on.

codes.meaning: Setup is past the point of gathering answers — it has been reviewed, is applying, or is finished. Nothing has been changed.
codes.name: ALREADY_UNDERWAY
codes.remedy: Resume or recover the setup in progress, or reconfigure a finished one.
codes.summary: Raised when setup is asked to gather answers for a wizard already past it.

codes.meaning: This machine already holds configuration, so setup is not what it needs. Answering setup again would walk a working stack back to its first question. Nothing has been changed.
codes.name: ALREADY_SET_UP
codes.remedy: Change the setting you came to change, with `lemonfiber config set <key> <value>`.
codes.summary: Raised when setup is answered on a machine that is already set up.

codes.meaning: A recovery was asked for and no setup here stopped part-way through applying. Recovering chooses what to do about a half-written apply, and there is none to choose about. Nothing has been changed.
codes.name: NOTHING_TO_RECOVER
codes.remedy: Ask where setup stands, with `lemonfiber setup --status`, before choosing a way out of it.
codes.summary: Raised when a recovery is asked for and no apply stopped part-way.

codes.meaning: Reversing a change left some settings exactly as they are. They no longer hold what lemonfiber wrote, so they were changed after it, and putting the old value back would take away a decision you made. Everything else was put back, and the message names the ones it left alone.
codes.name: NOT_PUT_BACK
codes.remedy: Set them back by hand if the earlier value is the one you want.
codes.summary: Raised when a reversal would write over a setting the operator has since chosen.

codes.meaning: Reversing a change met a credential the journal had sealed and this machine can no longer open — the key kept beside the journal is missing, or the record was changed after it was written. What those settings held is not something to put back, so they were left exactly as they are and the message names them. Everything else was put back.
codes.name: NOT_OPENED
codes.remedy: Set them yourself, from wherever the earlier credential came from.
codes.summary: Raised when a reversal meets a credential whose sealed record will not open.

codes.meaning: Reversing a change met directories that hold something this run did not put there. A directory lemonfiber made comes off on the way back only while it is empty, because taking one that holds files would take those files with it. Everything else was put back, and the message names the directories.
codes.name: STILL_HOLDING
codes.remedy: Look at what is inside, then remove them by hand if nothing there is wanted.
codes.summary: Raised when a directory a reversal would remove still holds something else's files.

codes.meaning: A region lemonfiber wrote into one of the stack's files could not be taken out. Everything before it was put back; the region is still in the file, between the markers that name whose it is.
codes.name: NOT_WITHDRAWN
codes.remedy: Delete the region by hand, markers included, or run the reversal again.
codes.summary: Raised when a region a reversal would take out of a stack file cannot be.

codes.meaning: A file lemonfiber wrote over could not be written back to what it held. Everything before it was put back; this file still holds what lemonfiber wrote, and the message names it.
codes.name: NOT_REWOUND
codes.remedy: Run the reversal again once the file can be written.
codes.summary: Raised when a file a reversal would write back to what it held cannot be.

codes.meaning: There is no room left, so nothing new is being fetched. A service that cannot write its database can take the file with it, which turns a full disk into work that is gone — fetching more onto it is what this prevents.
codes.name: HALTED
codes.remedy: Free space, then run this again. `lemonfiber space` names an offer, and answering it takes what it offers.
codes.summary: Raised when the volume is full and new acquisitions are therefore halted.

codes.meaning: No data location is configured, so there is no disk to account for.
codes.name: NOWHERE_TO_MEASURE
codes.remedy: Set the data location, with `lemonfiber setup`.
codes.summary: Raised when there is no data location to measure.

codes.meaning: The data location is there and could not be read.
codes.name: WALK_REFUSED
codes.remedy: Check that the account lemonfiber runs as can read the data location.
codes.summary: Raised when the data location is there and could not be read.

codes.meaning: There is no torrent client here to be holding a completed download. Seeding is a torrent client's business, and this stack has none lemonfiber can reach and prove itself to.
codes.name: NOTHING_TO_ASK
codes.remedy: Check the download client is running and lemonfiber knows its password. `lemonfiber doctor` says which.
codes.summary: Raised when there is no torrent client here to be holding a completed download.

codes.meaning: The client answered and is holding nothing of the name given. One that has finished seeding, or was removed already, is not there to be removed again.
codes.name: NOT_HELD
codes.remedy: Read the account and name one of the completed downloads it lists, with `lemonfiber space`.
codes.summary: Raised when the client answers and is holding nothing of the name given.

codes.meaning: The answer names an offer that is not the one standing now. What an offer covers is in the name it goes by — for one download, what it occupies, where it stands and the ratio it has earned; for a cleanup, every path it would take and what each occupies — so an offer that has moved since it was read is a different offer.
codes.name: ANOTHER_OFFER
codes.remedy: Read the offer again, and answer the name it prints.
codes.summary: Raised when an agreement names an offer that is not the one standing now.

codes.meaning: The client could not be reached, or would not let the download go. It is still being seeded and the room is still spent, which is the honest reading.
codes.name: STILL_HELD
codes.remedy: Check the download client is answering, then answer the offer again.
codes.summary: Raised when the client could not be reached, or would not let a download go.

codes.meaning: No readable manifest was found where a stack was expected. A stack directory holds a `stack.toml` beside its compose files.
codes.name: STACK_UNREADABLE
codes.remedy: Point at a directory containing `stack.toml`, with `lemonfiber --stack-dir <path>`.
codes.summary: Raised when a stack directory holds no readable manifest.

codes.meaning: The manifest is readable and was written for a different version of lemonfiber.
codes.name: STACK_UNUSABLE
codes.remedy: Update lemonfiber, or point at a stack this version reads.
codes.summary: Raised when a manifest is readable and this build cannot use it.

codes.meaning: This build of lemonfiber is not intact: the stack that ships inside the binary is missing. The build is supposed to make this impossible.
codes.name: STACK_NOT_EMBEDDED
codes.remedy: Nothing is known to fix this. Send a [support bundle](https://docs.lemonfiber.app/fixing/the-support-bundle/).
codes.summary: Raised when the embedded stack is not intact.

codes.meaning: There is nowhere to write the stack, because no location has been chosen.
codes.name: STACK_NOT_SET_UP
codes.remedy: Run `lemonfiber setup`.
codes.summary: Raised when lemonfiber has nowhere to write the stack.

codes.meaning: The stack could not be written to disk, so nothing can start. Usually a permission problem or a full disk.
codes.name: STACK_NOT_WRITTEN
codes.remedy: Check the location is writable and has space.
codes.summary: Raised when the stack could not be written to disk.

codes.meaning: The manifest parses and contradicts itself: it says things about itself that cannot all be true.
codes.name: STACK_INVALID
codes.remedy: Fix the faults listed under the message. All of them were found in one pass.
codes.summary: Raised when a manifest parses and breaks the contract.

codes.meaning: The file is not written in the format a `stack.toml` uses, so nothing in it has been read. The message names the line the reader stopped on.
codes.name: STACK_MALFORMED
codes.remedy: Fix the file at the line the message names.
codes.summary: Raised when a manifest is not TOML at all.

codes.meaning: The file is well formed and declares things in words this version of lemonfiber has no meaning for — usually a stack from a newer lemonfiber, or one with something of its own added. Starting it would quietly leave out whatever was named.
codes.name: STACK_UNRECOGNISED
codes.remedy: Update lemonfiber, or change the named declarations to ones it knows. Every one of them is listed, found in a single pass.
codes.summary: Raised when a manifest declares names this build does not know.

codes.meaning: The stack names the oldest lemonfiber it works with, and the one running is older. It relies on something this version cannot do, so nothing in it is started rather than started in part. The message names both versions.
codes.name: STACK_NEEDS_NEWER
codes.remedy: Update lemonfiber to the version named, with `lemonfiber update self`. Or point at a stack this version runs, with `lemonfiber --stack-dir <path>`.
codes.summary: Raised when a stack names a newer lemonfiber than the one running.

codes.meaning: The stack's manifest files are not laid out as a stack is: a `stack.toml` whose `include` list names one file per service under `services/`, each describing one service. Which services the stack holds cannot be told, so nothing in it was started. A stack that keeps every service in `stack.toml` itself is refused this way.
codes.name: STACK_UNASSEMBLED
codes.remedy: Fix the files named under the message. All of them were found in one pass.
codes.summary: Raised when a manifest's files are not laid out as the contract says.

codes.meaning: The data location cannot hardlink, so imports copy: each takes minutes rather than being instant, uses twice the disk while it runs, and torrents cannot seed from the library copy. Where the filesystem type explains it — exFAT, FAT, SMB, NFS, the WSL2 boundary — the message names that.
codes.name: COPY_ONLY
codes.remedy: Choose a location that hardlinks, or continue in copy mode. The services are configured to copy, so imports still work.
codes.summary: Raised when the data root cannot hardlink, so imports must copy.

codes.meaning: The data location exists and cannot be written to. The services have to own what they import, so every import fails far from where the cause shows.
codes.name: ROOT_UNWRITABLE
codes.remedy: Give the account that runs the services write access to the data location.
codes.summary: Raised when the data root exists but cannot be written to.

codes.meaning: The data location could not be reached. A stack that wrote into a missing mount point would build a phantom library on the system disk.
codes.name: ROOT_ABSENT
codes.remedy: Check the location exists and any drive holding it is connected.
codes.summary: Raised when the data root is not there to test.

codes.meaning: Free space is low, or is projected to run out against what is already queued. A disk that fills partway through an import leaves half a file behind and stalls the queue.
codes.name: SPACE_LOW
codes.remedy: Free space on the data location, thin the download queue, or move it to a larger volume.
codes.summary: Raised when the volume holding the data root is nearly full.

codes.meaning: The data location used to hardlink and no longer does — usually a drive that came back mounted with different options. Every import since has been copying.
codes.name: DEGRADED
codes.remedy: Check how the data location is mounted, and remount it as it was. A network share remounted without the right options is the common cause.
codes.summary: Raised when the data root used to hardlink and no longer does.

codes.meaning: You own the data location and the containers cannot write it: they run as one user and group, and the directory's ownership and mode do not allow them. Imports fail inside the services.
codes.name: SERVICE_DENIED
codes.remedy: Give the service user ownership of the data location, or write access to it.
codes.summary: Raised when the operator owns the data root but the services cannot write it.

codes.meaning: A service sees more than one mount beneath the data location, so each is its own filesystem inside the container and a file moved between them is copied rather than linked. Nothing is broken — imports take longer and use twice the space.
codes.name: SPLIT_MOUNTS
codes.remedy: Mount the data location once and keep the downloads and the library as directories beneath it. Where the layout is deliberate, `lemonfiber doctor --accept storage.single-mount` settles it.
codes.summary: Raised where a service would see more than one mount beneath the data location, so anything imported between them is copied rather than linked.

codes.meaning: The stack is copying imports where it was set up to hardlink them, because the data location stopped hardlinking under it. Imports still work, using twice the disk.
codes.name: COPYING_SINCE_DEGRADED
codes.remedy: Restore the location's hardlink support, then run the storage check again.
codes.summary: Raised where a location that stopped hardlinking leaves the stack copying in a mode it was not set up for.

codes.meaning: The household is told about less than lemonfiber now sets out to tell them, through no choice of yours. A newer version sends more than what is currently wired in.
codes.name: BEHIND
codes.remedy: Bring what the household is told up to what lemonfiber now sends, by running `lemonfiber seed`.
codes.summary: Raised when the household is told about less than lemonfiber now sets out to tell them, through no choice of the operator's.

codes.meaning: A screen could not be drawn. The terminal stopped accepting output, which usually means it was closed or resized out from under the process.
codes.name: DRAWING
codes.remedy: Run it again in a terminal that stays open.
codes.summary: A screen that could not be drawn, as a problem rather than a panic.

codes.meaning: No run in the record carries the stamp you asked for. It may have fallen outside the horizon the record keeps, or the stamp may be mistyped. Nothing was put back.
codes.name: NO_SUCH_RUN
codes.remedy: Run `lemonfiber history` and take the stamp from the entry you want.
codes.summary: Raised when no run carries the stamp a reversal was asked for.

codes.meaning: The stamp names more than one run, and putting back the wrong one is not something to guess at. Nothing was put back.
codes.name: MORE_THAN_ONE_RUN
codes.remedy: The message names each run the stamp covers; ask for one of them once the surfaces carry it.
codes.summary: Raised when a stamp names more than one run, so which to put back is not settled.

codes.meaning: One change in the run cannot be reversed, and a run goes back whole or not at all — so nothing was put back. The message names the change and why it will not go. Raised by a command that made a change, it means the change was made and could not be written to the change journal: the change stands, and cannot be put back, because a reversal reads the journal.
codes.name: CANNOT_SUCCEED
codes.remedy: Deal with that change first, or restore from a backup. Where a change could not be recorded, check that lemonfiber's configuration directory can be written and has space.
codes.summary: Raised when a run cannot be put back, carrying the reason it cannot.

codes.meaning: This run has nowhere it knows to look for what was changed. What lemonfiber changed is recorded in its own directory, and this machine would not say where that is. Nothing was put back.
codes.name: NOWHERE_TO_LOOK
codes.remedy: Set a home directory for this user and run it again.
codes.summary: Raised when a run cannot say where lemonfiber's own files are.

codes.meaning: What is running could not be read, so no update was worked out. Which version each service stands on is the container engine's answer, and it did not give one. Nothing was changed.
codes.name: NOT_CHECKED
codes.remedy: Start the container engine, then ask again.
codes.summary: Raised when what this machine has pulled could not be read.

codes.meaning: An update was narrowed to one service by a name the stack does not declare. A name matching nothing would otherwise read as a stack already up to date, so it is refused instead. Nothing was changed.
codes.name: NO_SUCH_SERVICE
codes.remedy: Name one of the services the stack declares; the message lists them.
codes.summary: Raised when the service an update was narrowed to is not one the stack declares.

codes.meaning: Something is still coming down, and the run was not asked to wait. Updating stops the download clients, and what is part-way down does not always resume where it left off — so a run that would interrupt one is refused rather than carried out. Nothing was changed.
codes.name: STILL_TRANSFERRING
codes.remedy: Let them finish with `lemonfiber update stack --confirm --wait`, or wait and ask again.
codes.summary: Raised when transfers are still in flight and the run was not asked to wait.

codes.meaning: The stack was stopped so the backup could run against databases nothing was writing to, and the backup would not write. Nothing was updated and nothing opened its state on a newer image, so there is nothing to undo — but the stack is down, because stopping it is what came first.
codes.name: CAPTURE_LEFT_IT_DOWN
codes.remedy: Bring the stack back up with `lemonfiber up`, then fix what stopped the capture and ask again.
codes.summary: Raised when the stack came down for the capture and the capture would not write.

codes.meaning: What was agreed to is not what the update would apply now. A newer release arrived, or one was withdrawn, since the update was rehearsed, so nothing was updated.
codes.name: UPDATE_MOVED
codes.remedy: Rehearse the update again, and answer the offer it gives now.
codes.summary: Raised where an update names an offer that is not the one a fresh look at the releases builds.

codes.meaning: The download client's traffic is not going through the VPN: its public address does not match the tunnel's, or it has connectivity the tunnel does not. Peers in every swarm can see your home address. This is the one failure whose consequences reach outside your machine.
codes.name: LEAKING
codes.remedy: Stop torrent transfers now, then confirm the client shares the VPN's network — `network_mode: service:<gateway>` in the stack.
codes.summary: Raised when the download client's egress does not match the tunnel.

codes.meaning: The VPN container that should carry traffic is not running. Nothing routes through a tunnel that is not up, so torrents cannot transfer — though nothing is leaking while it is down.
codes.name: VPN_CONTAINER_DOWN
codes.remedy: Start the form that includes it, then read its logs: `lemonfiber logs <gateway>`.
codes.summary: Raised when the VPN container that should carry traffic is not running.

codes.meaning: The tunnel is up and the client could not reach the internet through it. Nothing is leaking, and torrents will not transfer until it can.
codes.name: CLIENT_ISOLATED
codes.remedy: Confirm the client uses the VPN container's network.
codes.summary: Raised when the client cannot reach the internet through the tunnel.

codes.meaning: The tunnel is up and no port was forwarded, so peers cannot open connections to your client: download connectivity and seeding are both reduced. It cannot be fixed while the stack is running.
codes.name: NO_FORWARDED_PORT
codes.remedy: Regenerate the VPN credentials with port forwarding enabled. On ProtonVPN that means enabling NAT-PMP and picking a P2P server when the WireGuard configuration is generated.
codes.summary: Raised when port forwarding was asked for but the provider granted no port.

codes.meaning: The tunnel was dropped on purpose and the download client still reached the internet. Every torrent would continue in the open the moment the VPN fails, and a VPN that never fails is not a thing.
codes.name: KILLSWITCH_LEAKS
codes.remedy: Enable the tunnel container's own killswitch. For gluetun that is `FIREWALL=on`, which is its default.
codes.summary: The code a stack whose traffic survives its tunnel earns.

codes.meaning: The killswitch test dropped the tunnel and could not confirm putting it back. The stack is left without one, and whether traffic is flowing outside it is exactly what is now unknown.
codes.name: TUNNEL_NOT_RESTORED
codes.remedy: Restart the tunnel container now.
codes.summary: The code a stack whose tunnel could not be put back earns.

codes.meaning: The provider forwards one port and the download client is listening on another. Downloads still arrive, so nothing looks wrong — but no peer can reach the client, so it cannot seed and connects to fewer sources.
codes.name: PORT_MISMATCH
codes.remedy: Run `lemonfiber up` to move the client onto the forwarded port.
codes.summary: Raised when the client is listening somewhere other than the forwarded port.

codes.meaning: The stack declares torrents and no VPN-contained client to run them through, so every torrent is visible under this connection's own address — to the network it is on, and to every peer in the swarm.
codes.name: NO_TUNNEL
codes.remedy: Put the torrent client behind a VPN container in the stack. Where this is deliberate, answer it once with `lemonfiber doctor --accept vpn.unprotected`.
codes.summary: Raised when torrents are configured with nothing containing them.

codes.meaning: No data location is configured, so there is nothing for a watch to guard.
codes.name: NOTHING_TO_WATCH
codes.remedy: Run `lemonfiber setup` to choose a data location, then start the watch again.
codes.summary: Raised when a watch is asked for but no data location is configured to watch.

codes.meaning: The data location is already gone when the watch was asked to start. A watch can only guard a location that is present when it begins.
codes.name: ALREADY_GONE
codes.remedy: Connect the drive or mount holding the data location, then start the watch.
codes.summary: Raised when the data location is already gone when the watch is asked to start.

codes.meaning: There is no service by that name in this stack, so it cannot fill anything. Nothing was changed.
codes.name: NO_SUCH_FILLER
codes.remedy: List the services with `lemonfiber catalogue`, then see what is wired with `lemonfiber wiring`.
codes.summary: A capability was named that no service in this stack provides.

codes.meaning: Two readings under one code. As an error: the service does not declare that capability, and pointing everything that asked at it would point them at something that cannot answer. As an advisory: the service already fills it, so nothing was changed and nothing needed to be.
codes.name: CANNOT_FILL
codes.remedy: See which services declare it with `lemonfiber plugin capabilities`, and what is wired now with `lemonfiber wiring`.
codes.summary: The service named cannot do the thing it was asked to fill.

codes.meaning: Nothing in this stack asks for that capability, so choosing who fills it would record a setting no wiring reads. Nothing was changed.
codes.name: NOTHING_ASKS
codes.remedy: See what the stack does ask for with `lemonfiber wiring`.
codes.summary: Nothing in this stack asks for the capability, so a choice would change nothing.

codes.meaning: Which service fills a capability is a setting, and there is no settings file to record it in. Nothing was changed.
codes.name: CHOICE_UNWRITABLE
codes.remedy: Set this machine up first, with `lemonfiber setup`.
codes.summary: The setting recording the choice could not be written.

codes.meaning: The choice answers a reading of the wiring that has since moved, or what is installed changed while the choice was being made. Agreeing to it now would be agreeing to something nobody saw, so nothing was changed; the message names what moved.
codes.name: WIRING_MOVED
codes.remedy: Read the choice again, and answer the name it prints.
codes.summary: Raised when a choice answers an offer that was read against a wiring that has since moved.

codes.meaning: The reason given for the choice cannot be recorded with it. A reason is read on one line beside the choice it explains, so it may be at most 280 characters and hold no line break or other control character. Nothing was changed.
codes.name: UNREASONABLE
codes.remedy: Say why in one shorter line, or make the choice with no reason.
codes.summary: Raised when the reason given for a choice is longer than a reason may be, or holds a line break or another control character.

codes.meaning: The service asked for already fills the capability, so nothing was changed, and nothing needed to be.
codes.name: ALREADY_FILLS
codes.remedy: Nothing to do. `lemonfiber wiring` lists what fills each capability.
codes.summary: Raised where the service chosen already fills the capability, so there is nothing to change.

codes.meaning: A service and its download client have drifted apart. Either the client still files under a category lemonfiber has moved on from, so anything filed since is somewhere the rest of the stack no longer looks; or you moved the client off lemonfiber's category and the service can no longer reach it, so the queue fills and never empties.
codes.name: DRIFTED
codes.remedy: Let lemonfiber bring it up to date with `lemonfiber doctor --fix`. To keep your own value instead, adopt it with `lemonfiber adopt`; to discard it and restore lemonfiber's, run `lemonfiber reset --confirm`.
codes.summary: Raised when a download client no longer files where lemonfiber wired it.

codes.meaning: The word you asked about is not one this product explains. What it explains is this ecosystem's own vocabulary — the words that are load-bearing and cannot be guessed. Having no entry is not the same as meaning nothing, and nothing is wrong with the stack.
codes.name: UNRECOGNISED
codes.remedy: Ask about one of the words its reports use. The message lists every word it knows.
codes.summary: A word this product does not explain, as a refusal that says what it does. Through the error model rather than a bare line, so it carries a code and a way forward like every other refusal — and the way forward is the list itself, which is short enough to be the answer rather than a pointer at one. It lies in the naming: the word is the whole of what was asked for, and there is no entry for it. A surface that reported this as its own failure would be telling a caller to try again at something that will never work.
